recognize_zh: 箭頭所指細胞的核膜已消失，濃縮的染色體呈放射狀排列（中期分裂相，正面觀），細胞質淡藍；旁邊兩個淋巴瘤細胞核輪廓不規則、細胞質少，在乾淨的腦脊髓液背景中顯示為高增殖的淋巴瘤細胞。
features: Mitotic figure (arrow) with condensed chromosomes arranged radially in a metaphase rosette, no nuclear membrane
Mitotic cell with moderate pale blue cytoplasm and blebbed outline
Two adjacent medium-to-large atypical lymphoid cells with irregular nuclear contours
Atypical cells with fine to slightly coarse chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm
describe_en: Cytocentrifuge preparation of cerebrospinal fluid shows a paucicellular specimen containing a small group of atypical cells. One cell is in metaphase, with condensed chromosomes arranged in a radial rosette and no nuclear membrane. The adjacent cells are medium to large atypical lymphoid cells with irregular nuclear contours, blastoid chromatin, and scant basophilic cytoplasm. In a patient with known blastoid mantle cell lymphoma, findings are consistent with CNS involvement by lymphoma; flow cytometry of the CSF is recommended for confirmation.

ddx.dx: Reactive lymphocytes in CSF (e.g., viral meningitis)
ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes are polymorphous with mature chromatin and mitoses are rare; flow cytometry shows no light-chain restriction.
Lymphoblasts have finer chromatin and very high N:C ratio and are TdT-positive, whereas blastoid MCL is TdT-negative and cyclin D1-positive.
Carcinoma cells form cohesive clusters with abundant cytoplasm and are keratin-positive rather than dispersed lymphoid cells.
